what: Repeat-Protect fix: do quiescence (every playout plays one more turn before the leaf), a flat table played by the prior, and an unbundled mega row cut the search's repeat Protect toward the human rate without costing strength? Written 2026-09-27 BEFORE the first game of any run below.
defect: docs/_reports/2026-09-26-protect-overuse.md: offered a repeat Protect by DODUO, gen5's depth-0 search puts ~0.61 of its row mix on it at 48 passes. Arena at 1 s vs DODUO-greedy (P-after): protect share 15.8%, fail rate 10.4%, consecutive share 13.9%, 60.5% of consecutive failed. Humans 12.4% / 3.6%.
diagnosis_before_the_run: solver/tests/probe_protect_cells.js on the 13 offered positions at 96 passes: the die is sampled right (success 0.374 over the repeat-row playouts, engine 0.333 at counter 1); the per-cell SE is small (median 0.0024) and the two halves of the passes give the same mass (0.626 / 0.607), so it is not noise; scored on its FAILED playouts only the repeat row keeps 0.054 of the mass, so its whole value is the success branch; and in most success branches the shielded body is alive at the leaf and dead one turn later to the same column. The depth-0 leaf credits a delayed KO: the horizon effect. Two smaller mechanisms in the same 13 positions: (a) in a position already lost inside the horizon every row is ~0 and the pick among them is decided below the leaf's resolution (a Protect that delays the loss by 1e-4 took the whole mix); (b) the ONE reserved mega row was the prior's top mega joint, and three times it carried the repeat Protect in with the mega, so the table could buy the mega only with the Protect.
fix: Three options, all on in X (spec fields; solver/mew/agent.js searchExtras): (1) quiesce 'all' — solver/miltank/rollout.js QUIESCENCE: every playout plays one extension turn after the stepped turn, before the leaf; each side repeats its non-protect moves, a slot that protected takes DODUO's best non-protect move for that slot at the root, anything else draws a non-protect move from the slot's menu. One horizon for every cell. (The first version extended only the playouts in which a protect held — mode 'held'; measured on the probe positions it scored protect rows one turn deeper than their neighbours and moved one position's repeat mass UP, 0.913 -> 0.991, so it was replaced before any game.) (2) flatEps 0.001 — solver/miltank/search.js: when every played cell is within 0.001 of every other, the ranking prior's top joint is played (counted flatPrior). (3) reserveNoRepeat — the reserved mega row is the prior's best mega joint that repeats no stall-rolling move, when one exists (counted megaUnbundled). Probe (solver/tests/probe_protect_passes.js, 40 positions, 48 passes): mass played on repeat rows when offered 0.611 (8/13 sampled) -> 0.200 (2/10); per position with the counter 0.199 -> 0.050. Cost at 1 s on the true battle, interleaved: 172.6 -> 133.3 playouts per decision (solver/tests/probe_quiesce_cost.js).

arms.X: solver/results/2026-09-27-protect-repeat/gen5-quiesce.json — gen5 with quiesce 'all', flatEps 0.001, reserveNoRepeat true
arms.Y: solver/machamp/league/gen5.json — current main (quiescence off; the code path with q absent is the pre-fix playout, test-miltank-quiesce OFF)

team_store: data/team-pool-frozen-regmc (games.bo3.jsonl sha256 a68263bb..., TEST pairs, solver/mew/pairs.js)
budget: 1 s per decision for both arms (the league spec budgetMs 1000): equal wall-clock

runs.G: solver/machamp/gate.js --release eaa5becc54eb --x solver/results/2026-09-27-protect-repeat/gen5-quiesce.json --y solver/machamp/league/human-clone.json --pairs 100 --pair-seed 1 --seed 26100 --workers 3 --cap 50 --info honest --rule notlose --team-store data/team-pool-frozen-regmc  (the SAME pairs and seeds as 2026-09-26 P-after, so gen5's 0.660 and its protect counts are the matched control)

measures: solver/arena/protect_stats.js per game and side, summed per arm by solver/arena/protect_read.js (share, fail rate, consecutive share, consecutive failed). S's protect figures are the COUNTED pairs only.

bars.fail: G's X arm fail rate <= 7.2% (2x the human 3.6%), and S's X arm fail rate below S's Y arm.
bars.consecutive: G's X arm consecutive share <= 7.0% (half of gen5's 13.9% on the same pairs and seeds).
bars.share: G's X arm protect share <= 15.5% (1.25x the human 12.4%).
bars.strength: S: H1 = X stronger by 20 Elo; H0 = X not stronger by 20. 'No strength loss' is read from S's Wilson 95% at the stop: a loss is SHOWN only if its upper bound is below 0.5. No bound by 2,000 games = INCONCLUSIVE, reported with the score and interval. Read once, at the bound.
bars.vs_doduo_greedy: G's score against DODUO-greedy, reported beside gen5's 0.660 [0.592, 0.722] on the same pairs and seeds; rule notlose (upper bound >= 0.5).

deploy_rule: gen5.json (the league champion spec, which ROTOM's miltank-gen5 and MACHAMP read) gets quiesce: true only if S does NOT accept H0 with a shown loss (upper bound < 0.5) AND the fail bar holds. Otherwise the flag stays off and the fix is reported as not deployed.
caveat_declared_before: Shared machine; other agents' runs may be live, and PORYGON2 v1 training and the adaptive clock are being built beside this. Both arms of S share each worker process and its load, so the equal-wall-clock comparison is paired. 'failed' includes a click that never executed (flinch, sleep) on every arm alike.
